description: Your observatory has archived waveform data from the 2024 Noto Peninsula M7.5 earthquake recorded at three GE-network stations (GSI, BKB, SANI) in the SDS archive for day 2024-001. The automatic processing pipeline was not running during the event, so no automatic detections exist in the database. You need to configure and execute a complete offline processing pipeline to retroactively detect and locate the event from the archived data. This requires setting up the appropriate automatic processing modules with station bindings and suitable filter parameters for teleseismic detection, then running the data through the pipeline. The end state should be: automatic phase picks detected at each station, at least one automatically located origin in the database, and a summary written to /home/ga/Desktop/playback_results.txt listing the number of automatic picks and origins found.
